jobs_results.title: Sr Backend Developer - Ruby, Ruby on Rails
jobs_results.description:
About Zen Educate

Our mission is to change the world of education recruitment. Schools spend over £2bn a year on agency staff, with over £600m per year of that spent on fees that go straight to the recruitment agencies. So far, we've saved UK schools over £10m in supply teaching recruitment costs, and that number grows every day, meaning the funding can be put back into education within the schools. Using our online platform, schools have access to hundreds of profiles of fully vetted teachers and support staff, who they can book at a click of a button. Think Uber for teachers. We are well-funded by high-profile investors and are led by start-up veterans behind two of London's most prominent tech companies.

Building on the success of Zen Educate, in 2020 we launched Zen Locum — an online platform that matches locums (temporary workers) with pharmacies and opticians. With significant early traction we're looking to expand this team to continue driving growth.

We're well-funded by... high-profile investors and are led by start-up veterans behind two of London’s most prominent tech companies.

About The Role

Our mission is to change the world of education recruitment. Schools spend over £2bn a year on agency staff, with over £600m per year of that spent on fees that go straight to the recruitment agencies. So far, we've saved UK schools over £10m in supply teaching recruitment costs, and that number grows every day, meaning the funding can be put back into education within the schools. Using our online platform, schools have access to hundreds of profiles of fully vetted teachers and support staff, who they can book at a click of a button. Think Uber for teachers. We are well-funded by high-profile investors and are led by start-up veterans behind two of London's most prominent tech companies.

What You’ll Do

You’ll be joining Zen in a key position. The product delivery team is a crucial part of how Zen will help both transform the supply and recruitment experience for schools and generate the savings the education system needs. This is a great opportunity for someone looking to apply themselves for a great cause and with great responsibility and autonomy to shape our product and development for years to come. We're looking for talented engineer looking to take their skills to the next level by joining a growing, high-performing product delivery team in an agile environment. You'll be:
• Picking up, owning and deploying new features from scratch, working closely with front-end developers
• Reviewing PRs and helping us improve our ways of working
• Investigating and tackling new challenges and responding to bugs
• Writing high quality, well-tested code

What You’ll Bring
• Experience with Ruby, Ruby on Rails (6yrs+)
• Experience refactoring legacy code and considering trade-offs around technical debt - A top performer that wants to be part of a high-performing, motivated team
• Growth mindset — dedicated to growing your skills as a professional
• Passion for work with a positive social impact

jobs_results.title: Senior Ruby on Rails Engineer
jobs_results.description:
What your new job and team will be like:

You will be joining a distributed team that is hard focused on the essential development of features which are allowing the company to continue growing. This work will be carried out within an environment focused on the balance between fostering growth and adherence to best practices (eg. test driven development, clean coding, functional programming, etc). While you will be mainly working in Ruby on Rails your experience with other tools will be highly valued as it will add to the success of the team in building, deploying and maintaining their web based applications.

What we would like to see in you:
• Experience with developing in Ruby on Rails or solid experience with similar technologies and proven track record of quickly adapting to new environments and tools.
• Preference for adherence to best practices and demonstrable understanding of efficient and productive development philosophies and methodologies (eg. Agile, TDD, Functional... Programming).
• Ability to communicate in English at a professional level.
• Strong drive to collaborate within a team, supporting in the growth of colleagues while also focusing on your own continued growth.

What you can expect in return:
• A culture and spirit focused on motivating you to keep growing, to be achieved through; active mentorship, access to courses and certifications and challenging projects which will help progress your technical knowledge by applying the skills you are learning within a practical context.
• 25 days off per year
• Private Health Insurance
• Work permit or relocation support to Spain (if the candidate needs/wants it) or the ability to work remotely (if based within +2/-1 Central European Time Zone).

The process you are going to succeed in:
• Short intro call (20 mins) with Good Roll.
• Interview with client People Team member.
• Technical Take Home Test & Subsequent Peer Review.
• Final Call to meet your new colleagues

jobs_results.title: Senior developer ruby on rails
jobs_results.description:
Importante empresa líder en su sector con sede en Valencia está buscando incorporar un/a Senior Developer especializado/a en Ruby on Rails (RoR) en remoto.

Dentro de tus funciones, te responsabilizarás principalmente de crear soluciones de calidad que mejoren los principales productos de la empresa, de acuerdo con la estrategia de la compañía, en un entorno colaborativo donde el código es propiedad de todos.

Para ello, tendrás que aportar una experiencia mínima de cinco años en desarrollo de Ruby on Rails, habiendo participado en decisiones técnicas sobre arquitectura. También se valorará experiencia en TDD, OOP y desarrollo web.

Además, buscamos una persona dinámica, con iniciativa y muchas ganas de aprender.

jobs_results.title: Senior ruby on rails developer
jobs_results.description:
Perfil buscado (Hombre/Mujer)

• Product development in Ruby/Rails of a hospitality-related web-based product.
• Integrations between our platform to 3rd party APIs.
• Work in an Agile environment with strong attention to scalability (We serve hundreds of thousands of unique visitors per month through our CMS).
• Discuss, question, challenge, and offer technical solutions to product needs alongside the Product and Design Teams.
• Being able to mentor, coach, and train other colleagues as a domain expert.
• Identify bottlenecks, bugs and propose solutions.

• Senior Ruby on Rails Developer
• International Start-up focused on the development of a disruptive SAAS product.
• Bachelor´s degree or equivalent practical experience.
• 6 years+ experience in web development.
• 3 years+ experience in Ruby.
• Proven knowledge of OOP, databases, development, and test methodologies.
• Obsession for quality and testing.
• Strong communication skills.

Our client is a Start-up with more than 5 years... of experience focused on the development of a brand new SAAS product, which will provide efficient and better solutions in terms of business administration.

The IT team is composed by a team of 10 people, mostly focused on Back-end development, and now, they are looking for someone who can manage all the Front-end needs.

They work in an international environment using English as the main language, and they also has bought new offices here in Barcelona.

• Remote policy: 1 week in the offices and 3 months of remote work.
• Free Insurance.
• Mac book is offered.
• Budget for training.
• Fresh Fruit and Coffee

jobs_results.title: .net engineer
jobs_results.description:
A career at Sage Barcelona puts you in one of the most beautiful cities on the planet, developing some of the world’s most transformative integrated business systems. Wherever you’re working right now, that probably sounds like a dream opportunity. Well, how about making it more than just a dream?

We’re offering an attractive relocation support package for the people with Ruby on Rails or .Net experience. The package includes help with accommodation, flights, legal fees and supporting your tax status as a Spanish resident. If you want to start a new life in a city that has everything, working in a friendly team as part of a global, growing business, read on to find out more.

About Sage:

We´re growing fast, and as a result, are expanding our Sage teams around the world. At present we are looking for a NET Developer who is talented, passionate and ambitious, to join our growing community for a role based in our Barcelona head office.

Our team is cross-functional and has... responsibility for delivering mission critical web

Reporting to the Development Team Leader, the Developer is responsible for building, enhancing and maintaining products and/or systems to enable Sage’s business plans and long term objectives using the identified architecture.

The Developer will design, develop and deliver high quality products and/or systems and services that exceed customers’ or business partners’ expectations and will proactively share their own knowledge for specific technical solutions and business processes in their area of responsibility.

Key accountabilities and decision ownership:

•Develop, deliver, maintain and implement high quality technical solutions
•Participate in all phases of the project lifecycle.
•Maintain relevant documentation to describe logic, coding/configuration, testing and changes where applicable.
•Continuously strive to make improvements to the existing products and/or systems and services.
•Seek out and act upon feedback.
•Other help and assistance to promote knowledge sharing.
•Ensure all tasks are completed to the required quality standards.

Skills, know-how and experience:

•Ability to interpret user requirements and translate these into technical specifications and/or code
•High numerical reasoning and logic ability with good problem solving skills
•Knowledge of one or more relevant programming languages, frameworks and databases (NET)
•Trouble shooting and/or problem solving skills
•Be an active and enthusiastic team player
•Be willing to adapt to significant changes in either technology or environment

Preferred:
•Innovative and creative thinking
•Delivering Results
•Customer Focus
•Computer Science (or related degree/qualification)
•Contribution to open source software projects
•Real world application development experience
•Technical / professional qualifications:

Competencies
•Customer Focused, at the forefront of providing service excellence.
•Action Oriented, able to take on new challenges with enthusiasm.
•Trustworthy, able to gain the confidence and trust of others easily and honour commitments.
•Innovative, able to spot opportunities to do things better and share best practice.
•Collaborative, building and maintaining strong working relationships and working with colleagues to meet shared goals.

Why would you love to work with us

Impact: You’ll be working alongside a tremendous team of highly skilled engineers on products that make a real impact on our customers
Culture: You will be working in a multicultural and diverse environment alongside highly motivated colleagues
Environment: Fantastic tech environment, using the best of breed and cutting-edge technologies
Competitive salary: We offer competitive salaries aligned with your experience and expertise
Flexibility: We believe in flexibility and work/life blend, offering flexible start times on the tech team

jobs_results.title: Lead backend developer
jobs_results.description:
Desde GeeksHubs estamos colaborando con una startup de Valencia que ha desarrollado un software de gestión, app de reservas, agenda digital y clases online que está revolucionando el uso del tiempo. Cada vez son más los clientes que confían en ellos y quieren ampliar su equipo y seguir mejorando para continuar ofreciendo el servicio líder en el mercado.

Estamos buscando un/a BACKEND DEVELOPER con experiencia de al menos dos años en entornos Ruby on Rails, Python o NodeJS para formar parte y liderar a su equipo de producto.

Las funciones del puesto son:
● Mantener la lógica de todas las secciones de la aplicación del panel de TIMP
● Desarrollar y mantener las APIs REST que consumen el resto de nuestras
aplicaciones
● Cooperar con el equipo técnico para mejorar el modelo de datos y el desempeño general del ecosistema
● Implementar y mantener el entorno de test del backend
● Liderar a un equipo joven y apasionado

Requisitos:
● Experiencia de al menos 2 años como Backend Developer en... entornos Ruby on Rails, Python o NodeJS.
● Limpieza de código.
● Desarrollo aplicando testing.
● Experiencia en desarrollo de APIs REST
● Experiencia con GIT
● Experiencia con metodologías ágiles de desarrollo
● Experiencia gestionando/liderando pequeños equipos de desarrollo

Tendrás puntos extra si aportas experiencia con...
● Conocimientos de Ruby y RoR
● Experiencia con infraestructuras cloud
● Experiencia con diversas Bases de Datos
